name: S08-iso-decision-chain-tamper
control: isolation decision chain (prev and sha256 per row)
note: Needs no VM. Each mode writes a fresh chain of rows, tampers once, then runs verify and one more append. tail_drop (cut after a full row) and append after edit or delete are measured in the detail but not asserted: the chain has no anchor of its expected head, and append does not verify beforehand.
